name: Rebekah Rebecca
overview: Rebekah, introduced as the daughter of Bethuel and grandniece of Abraham, becomes the wife of Isaac when he is forty years old, as recorded in Genesis 24 and 25. Isaac prays to the Lord on her behalf because she was initially barren, and God answers his prayer, allowing Rebekah to conceive. The narrative also highlights family dynamics, including Esau’s marriages to Hittite women, which displeased Rebekah, and her role in guiding Jacob’s actions later in life. These events emphasize God’s providence in the lineage of the patriarchs and the complex relationships within Abraham’s family.
